items.title: Copart (CPRT) Stock Looks Cheap Based On Its Earnings Price
items.summary: Copart shares have climbed in recent weeks despite a share price that is still well below where it was a few years ago. With the stock at US$31.93 at the last close, the key issue is whether that market price lines up with the profit power of the business. Over the past 3 years the stock has fallen 30.5%.
